rule: FL-M5 T7: serving benchmark and test-split accuracy per format, fixed before any test-split run

not_scored_on_test.rtn-w4a16: dev-only control for the AWQ row (QA Q182)

accuracy.split: test (65 rows, FL-M2 split; never used for prompts, training or choices)
accuracy.decoding: as on dev: zero-shot prompt, temperature 0, max 400 tokens, JSON schema, thinking off; vLLM with --gpu-memory-utilization 0.83 --max-model-len 4608 --max-num-seqs 1 (eager); llama-server with one slot (-np 1 -c 4608 -t 12 -tb 24 --jinja --seed 0)
accuracy.metric: category macro-F1 (primary), category accuracy, rule-valid rows

comparison.method: paired bootstrap of each build vs merged-bf16 on the same 65 rows (filinglens.train.compare: 2,000 resamples, seed 0, 95% percentile CI of b - a)
comparison.label_lower: 'lower than BF16' iff the upper end of the 95% CI of the macro-F1 difference is below 0

router_inputs: dev split only; test numbers appear in bench/serving.csv only

load.prompts: the dev-split extraction prompts (71), in order, cycled; the test split is never sent
load.decoding: same as accuracy, streamed with usage
load.loop: closed loop: exactly k requests in flight
load.vllm_server: python -m filinglens.serve.vllm_server --build <build> (gpu_memory_utilization 0.83, max_model_len 4608, max_num_seqs 16, CUDA graphs on)
load.recorded_per_row: TTFT p50/p95, latency p50/p95, output tokens/s, decode tokens/s per request, requests/s, errors, server VRAM (peak minus idle before start), GPU max temperature and mean power, power mode, KV-cache size from the server log
